subject: microbiology
title: Influenza, parainfluenza, RSV, measles, mumps, rubella and coronaviruses

steps.tx: **Influenza A** (segmented negative RNA, **H haemagglutinin with N neuraminidase**) escapes by **drift** (point mutations, yearly epidemics) and **shift** (reassortment, pandemics like 2009 H1N1); avian H5N1 and H7N9 spill with high mortality. Treatment is **oseltamivir** within 48 hours for high risk groups with yearly inactivated or live vaccines reformulated; **Reye syndrome** forbids aspirin in viral children. Diagnosis is rapid antigen or PCR with droplet precautions. B drifts only; C is mild.
steps.say: Shift pandemics, drift epidemics: H with N sorts flu. High risk flu gets oseltamivir in 2 days.

steps.tx: **Parainfluenza** causes **croup** (barking seal cough with **steeple sign** subglottic narrowing, worse at night, nebulised adrenaline with dexamethasone) while **RSV** (syncytia, infants) causes **bronchiolitis** (wheeze with hypoxia and apnoea, hyperinflated films, oxygen with fluids, **palivizumab** prophylaxis for preemies, ribavirin selected). Human metapneumovirus mimics RSV; adenovirus (pink eye with pharyngoconjunctival fever, military barracks) persists environmentally. Humidified oxygen beats antibiotics in both.
steps.say: Seal bark with steeple is croup: mist with steroids. Infant wheeze epidemic is RSV: oxygen, not antibiotics.

steps.tx: **Measles** (morbillivirus, cough coryza conjunctivitis with **Koplik spots** before maculopapular head to foot rash, infectious 4 days either side) kills by pneumonia and encephalitis; **vitamin A** halves mortality with **SSPE** (years later myoclonus with periodic EEG) haunting survivors. **Mumps** (paramyxovirus, parotitis with **orchitis** threatening fertility, aseptic meningitis, pancreatitis) and **rubella** (mild with posterior nodes, **congenital triad** of cataract, deafness and PDA with blueberry muffin rash) complete MMR targets; IgM with PCR confirms while support prevails.
steps.say: Koplik plus head to foot rash is measles: vitamin A saves. Parotid swelling with testicular pain is mumps.

steps.tx: **Coronaviruses** (enveloped positive RNA, crown spikes) range from common colds to **SARS, MERS and SARS-CoV-2** (zoonotic spillovers, anosmia with ground glass pneumonia, dexamethasone in hypoxia, antivirals per era guidance, vaccines blunting severity). **MMR strategy** (live attenuated, two doses, egg and gelatin cautions, pregnancy avoided a month) eliminates measles, mumps and rubella together; outbreaks signal coverage gaps needing catch up. Isolation with notification contains importations.
steps.say: Ground glass with anosmia is COVID until PCR rules out. Two MMR doses erase three diseases.
